title: Free lead sample
criteria: Eight distinct UK retailer records: one free example, five additional paid profiles and two reserves. Every selected retailer publishes retro-game buying or trade activity and a business contact. Match any sourcing trial to its own platform, region, condition and delivered-cost requirements.

leads.business_need: Hidden Chest describes itself as an independent shop, names Ant Harper as its console/computer specialist, and advertises refurbished Sinclair hardware. RetroGear explicitly states that it is part of Hidden Chest and buys old consoles, computers, games, peripherals and whole collections.
leads.contact_instructions: Co-manager; old-computer and console specialist. RetroGear invites collection sellers to request a quote by email. Current Hidden Chest contact information provides Ant's named business address plus the general shop mailbox hiddenchestgaming@gmail.com.
leads.geography: The Central Market Hall, High Street, Cradley Heath, B64 5HA, UK
leads.published_budget: No software or sourcing budget published.
leads.why_it_fits: A focused BuyHub sourcing trial could use separate saved searches and radars for a retailer-selected UK console or 8-bit-computer category. It could bring candidate listings into one review list while Ant retains physical condition, parts, modification, seller and purchase decisions. This is a hypothesis; the retailer's current marketplace use and software are unknown.
leads.opening_message: Ant, Hidden Chest's refurbished Sinclair range and RetroGear's collection-buying service caught my eye. Would a saved-search trial for one console or computer category you already buy be useful? BuyHub could surface candidate listings for your review, keeping model, region, condition and delivered cost separate.
leads.status_note: Public buying/trade activity checked on 13 October 2026. Ask which hardware families and countries the shop currently sources, whether PAL/UK units and imports need separate searches, what modifications or faults are acceptable, and whether peripherals, manuals or original packaging are required. Agree buyer-entered purchase and delivered-cost limits, then inspect actual listings; no sourcing budget, margin, active marketplace account or buying intent has been verified. Current Hidden Chest contact page gives Cradley Heath; RetroGear's Brierley Hill location and online sales text are older. Treat the two brands as one prospect, not two leads. RetroGear is browse-only and must not be described as a current online checkout.
